notes: Reviewed 2026-11-15: 15 min resuspension in urine is medium_or_oxygen_shift | Both strains grown in MOPS+tryptone+glucose to OD600 0.2, then resuspended 15 min in urine or MOPS. MOPS-resuspended samples are the controls of each strain. The urine shift is not a scheme treatment (medium change to a natural fluid), so treatment/exposure, carbon source and amino_acids_supplied are left out for urine samples. Phase mid_exponential inferred from OD 0.2 kept for the 15 min after the shift. rRNA removal not stated (TruSeq RNA kit).

culture_mode.q: both strains were grown with shaking at 37°C in 12ml MOPS media  supplemented with 0.2% tryptone and 0.2% glucose until the OD600 reached 0.2

oxygen.q: The re-suspended bacteria were grown for 15 additional minutes with shaking at 37°C

growth_temperature.q: grown for 15 additional minutes with shaking at 37°C
